products.name: Litwell
products.tagline: Search scientific papers, preprints and patents at once, and get one ranked Excel file.
summary: Litwell is a free, open-source desktop program for searching the published literature, preprint servers and patent offices without visiting each one separately. Enter a topic, tick any number of sources, and Litwell asks them all at the same time, merges the duplicates, filters out the obvious misses, scores what is left from 0 to 100, and saves it to one workbook on your computer.

Searches are exact by default: a topic such as B2 protein is searched as a phrase, not as two loose words. Add a must-contain list and an exclude list, save the whole set as a named profile, and see in the Search Log exactly how many rows each source and each rule removed.
features: Tick any of eight sources and search them together: PubMed, Crossref, OpenAlex, Europe PMC, arXiv, preprint servers, USPTO and EPO.
Match topics as an exact phrase, all words or any word; add Must also contain and Exclude terms; save and reuse named profiles.
A Relevance Score from 0 to 100 on every row, best first, from published rules. No AI and no key needed.
Abstracts, citation counts and free full-text links where the sources provide them; one row per paper even when several sources found it.
A workbook with Results, Summary, Search Log and Glossary sheets, and a New Since Last Run flag so repeat searches show only what is new.
Optional AI triage with a model on your own computer (Ollama, free); off by default, and nothing is sent to a cloud service.
A How-to Guide (PDF) built into the app. Open source under the Apache License 2.0.
sources: Publisher metadata and DOIs across all fields
Physics, mathematics, computer science and related preprints
bioRxiv, SSRN, OSF, ChemRxiv and other servers from the DOAPR directory, searched together
US granted patents and pending applications
Published patents and applications from patent offices worldwide

uspto: Sign in or create an account at data.uspto.gov.
In your account settings, generate or copy your API key.
In Litwell choose File → API Keys & Contact…, paste it into USPTO API key, and save.
epo: Sign in and create an app. You receive a Consumer Key and a Consumer Secret.
In Litwell choose File → API Keys & Contact…, paste both into the EPO fields, and save.

products.privacy: Searches go directly from your computer to the public databases. Litwell has no account system, and nothing is sent to us. Your results are saved wherever you choose, and your settings (including any keys you enter) are stored in a small file in your user folder.
